notes: Synthetic teaching inputs. No observed quotes, holdings, or price history. Not market-performance evidence.

134 trades were entered and none has a definable capital at risk, because this structure's maximum loss is unbounded. Return on risk has no denominator, so no statistic here can be computed. Every entry and exit is still in the trade list, and profit in cash terms is still there to read.
